title: GradShield: Alignment Preserving Finetuning
reasoning: The paper focuses on preserving 'safety alignment' in LLMs, ensuring they comply with 'ethical guidelines' and do not generate 'harmful content.' It evaluates its results using a 'Harmful Score' (HS) which specifically rates model behavior on a 5-point scale regarding its adherence to safety and ethical instructions, including judging if actions are 'unethical.'
